description: The U.K. National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) has recommended atezolizumab, within its marketing authorisation, as an option for untreated locally advanced or metastatic urothelial cancer in adults whose tumours express PD-L1 at a level of 5% or more, when cisplatin-containing chemotherapy is unsuitable. Atezolizumab is recommended within its marketing authorisation and subject to the commercial arrangement available to the NHS.
